next_step: Implement APFS compressed-file read support (read compressed xattr, decompress via zlib, reconstruct logical bytes). This is required not just for evidence but for the actual ramdisk mutation — the plists we need to replace are all compressed.

structural_finding: Every single LaunchDaemons plist in the iPhone15,4 iOS 27.0 restore ramdisk carries APFS_INOBSD_COMPRESSED (0x20) in bsd_flags. There are zero uncompressed plists in this directory. The first file-read gate requires either: (a) decompression support (zlib/decmpfs), or (b) targeting a file from a different directory (e.g., SystemVersion.plist under CoreServices). Option (a) is the production-correct path for the ramdisk patch pipeline since Apple compresses launchd plists by default.
